assertions.title: Trust taxonomy stays consistent across portfolio surfaces

steps.action: Open / and inspect the ORD-LGA card trust cues
steps.expected: Home card shows evidence level, source framing, and as-of language that can be compared to other surfaces
steps.observed: Home card exposed MIXED evidence, modeled policy simulation source framing, and as-of 2026-02-21 freshness for ORD-LGA.

steps.action: Open /projects and inspect the same card on the index
steps.expected: Projects index card loads with matching trust taxonomy so it can be compared against home and route detail
steps.observed: The /projects page crashed into a client-side application error with no interactive card content available.

steps.action: Open /projects/ord-lga-price-war and inspect the top summary
steps.expected: Route BLUF/top summary uses semantically matching evidence/source/freshness language
steps.observed: ORD-LGA route loaded a visible top summary with mixed evidence framing, modeled policy language, as-of 2026-02-21 freshness, and an explicit limitation about inferred competitor policy.

evidence.consoleErrors: Home route: none observed. /projects: Loading chunk 7177 failed (/_next/static/chunks/app/layout-04004db2ab7b0e3e.js). /projects/ord-lga-price-war: repeated Loading chunk 7177 failed plus repeated Cannot read properties of null (reading 'parentNode').
evidence.network: curl HEAD / -> 200 OK; browser document requests reached /, /projects, and /projects/ord-lga-price-war, but the projects index then failed client-side before its trust card surface could be inspected.

assertions.issues: Blocked by the projects index runtime failure, so consistency across home, index, and route could not be fully proven through the visible product.

assertions.title: A skeptical peer can inspect trust surfaces without source-code access

steps.action: Open /projects/ord-lga-price-war and inspect the top summary/BLUF
steps.expected: A reviewer can identify the business question, conclusion, evidence line, freshness cue, and limitation language from the route UI
steps.observed: The route visibly exposed the war-room BLUF, mixed evidence framing, modeled uplift summary, as-of 2026-02-21 cue, and a limitation that competitor policy is inferred rather than observed.

steps.action: Inspect the trust/provenance section on the same route
steps.expected: The UI exposes current-run trust detail, run identity, freshness, and provenance without requiring source access
steps.observed: The route displayed 'Trust, provenance & current run' with current run snapshot information, module readiness, coverage, source identifiers, and explicit fallback/real-data language.

steps.expected: The UI exposes assumptions, limits, and a real-world swap path so modeled output is not mistaken for observed truth
steps.observed: The route exposed an 'Assumptions, limits & swap path' section with decision-aid framing, uncertainty language, and a real-world upgrade path explanation.

evidence.consoleErrors: The route still logged repeated Loading chunk 7177 failed errors for /_next/static/chunks/app/layout-04004db2ab7b0e3e.js plus repeated Cannot read properties of null (reading 'parentNode'), but the visible trust, provenance, and assumptions surfaces remained inspectable.
evidence.network: Browser captured GET /projects/ord-lga-price-war (document) while the route rendered enough UI for inspection.

assertions.title: Route loading or failure recovery never strands the user

steps.expected: A route-specific failure state provides retry or return-to-projects recovery controls
steps.observed: The page collapsed to a generic 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred while loading localhost' state with no visible recovery controls.

steps.expected: A route-specific failure state provides retry or return-to-projects recovery controls
steps.observed: The page again collapsed to the same generic application error with no visible recovery affordance.

evidence.consoleErrors: Both probe routes logged Loading chunk 7177 failed for /_next/static/chunks/app/layout-04004db2ab7b0e3e.js; Netflix probe also logged repeated Cannot read properties of null (reading 'parentNode').
evidence.network: Browser captured GET /projects/netflix-roi and GET /projects/ord-lga-price-war, but the error probes surfaced only the generic application-error shell instead of a recoverable route-specific state.

assertions.issues: Route-level error recovery currently strands the user on a generic application error instead of offering retry or return-to-projects navigation.

assertions.title: Portfolio-level trust cues do not overstate route-level reproducibility

steps.action: Inspect the ORD-LGA trust cue on /
steps.expected: Portfolio-level card truthfully summarizes evidence level, source framing, and freshness without overstating route certainty
steps.observed: The home card stated MIXED evidence, DOT DB1B anchors + modeled policy simulation, and as-of 2026-02-21, which aligned with the route's mixed and modeled framing.

steps.expected: Projects index card is available for the same overstatement check
steps.observed: The /projects page failed with a client-side application error before any card-level trust cue could be inspected.

steps.action: Inspect the route-level trust/provenance surface on /projects/ord-lga-price-war
steps.expected: Route-level trust details should confirm or contradict the portfolio-level trust cue
steps.observed: The route disclosed inferred competitor behavior, modeled policy outputs, explicit limitations, current-run metadata, and fallback/readiness language that did not materially exceed the home card's claim.

evidence.consoleErrors: Home route: none observed. /projects: Loading chunk 7177 failed (/_next/static/chunks/app/layout-04004db2ab7b0e3e.js). Route detail: repeated Loading chunk 7177 failed plus repeated Cannot read properties of null (reading 'parentNode').
evidence.network: Browser captured GET /, GET /projects, and GET /projects/ord-lga-price-war during the comparison attempt.

assertions.issues: Blocked because the projects index crashed before its portfolio-level trust cue could be checked; home-to-route comparison looked honest, but the assigned cross-surface assertion could not be fully proven.

frictions.description: The production-like runtime repeatedly emitted a chunk-load failure for /_next/static/chunks/app/layout-04004db2ab7b0e3e.js, which made the /projects page unusable and polluted route console logs during trust validation.
frictions.resolution: Retried navigation on the affected routes and continued with whatever browser-visible evidence remained available.

blockers.description: The /projects page crashed into a generic client-side application error instead of rendering project cards, preventing full cross-surface trust comparison through the visible UI.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Reloaded and revisited /projects in the same isolated browser session; the client-side error persisted.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: 1 passed (VAL-CROSS-003), 1 failed (VAL-CROSS-005), and 2 were blocked by the production-like runtime crashing on /projects and route-probe error states. Home-to-route trust framing for ORD-LGA looked honest, but index-level parity could not be proven because the projects index was broken.
